Sloane Robinson Llp Holding in Banco Macro (BMA) Lowered as Shares Declined; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Fort Washington Investment Advisors Boosted Holding
May 24, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Hugh Sloane decreased its stake in Banco Macro (BMA) by 29.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sloane Robinson Llp sold 10,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.76% with the market. The hedge fund run by Hugh Sloane held 26,500 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.07 million, down from 37,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sloane Robinson Llp who had been investing in Banco Macro for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $80.01. About 175,267 shares traded. Banco Macro S.A. (NYSE:BMA) has risen 28.16% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.61% the S&P500.
Fort Washington Investment Advisors Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 39.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fort Washington Investment Advisors Inc bought 425,637 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.50 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $254.12 million, up from 1.08 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fort Washington Investment Advisors Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $925.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.01% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $188.37. About 15.99M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
